id: title:darkopia:stop reporting a cycle for fully routed branching

review.posthog_relevance: Survey branching and routing behavior, including support for rating questions and optional questions, and cycle prevention.
review.reason: The implementation hunk P1.F2.H1 restructures response-based branching to support rating questions and optional questions and prevents cycles when every response routes to a destination. This is a substantive, bounded correctness and capability improvement. P1.F1.H1 is a test-only hunk and does not contribute to the tier.
review.uncertainty: The benefit relies on the correctness of the restructuring and the absence of runtime cycles, which are not independently verified by execution or test results in this chunk. No adoption or incident avoidance is demonstrated.

observations.limitations: This chunk contains two hunks. P1.F1.H1 is a test file and P1.F2.H1 is the implementation. The implementation hunk P1.F2.H1 is the relevant change. P1.F1.H1 is not used for scoring.

observations.behavior: Adds response-based branching support for rating questions and optional questions, and prevents cycles when every response routes to a destination.
observations.code_quote: // The rule left by a deleted choice routes nobody, so its step back is unreachable.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds tests for survey branching behavior, including edge cases for deleted choices and optional questions, but does not change production behavior.
